standard_prerequisites.name: Symmetric algebra identification
standard_prerequisites.use: O_S[T_0..T_n] with the standard grading is Sym of O_S^{n+1}.

core_obligations: Write P^n_Z as the relative Proj of the sheafified polynomial algebra over Spec(Z).
Base change along g identifies P^n_S with the relative Proj of O_S[T_0..T_n].
O_S[T_0..T_n] is the symmetric algebra of O_S^{n+1}, so P^n_S is a projective bundle.
proof_roadmap: Express P^n_Z as a relative Proj, pull back along g, and identify the symmetric algebra.
difficulty_reason: Short base-change chain from the relative Proj of a polynomial algebra; fully displayed.
